tools.name: search_shop_products
tools.description: Browse equipment ideas in one of BeachFinder's ten categories. Normal BeachFinder tools already include one contextual Shop suggestion, so do not call this tool just to duplicate it. Returns original packing suggestions and a link to the matching Shop selection, not individual merchant offers, photos, prices or stock. No destination required; works for users in any country without guaranteeing product delivery there. French or English content (English fallback for other languages).

tools.name: search_beaches
tools.description: Find public beaches by city or consented coordinates and rank them for swimming, family, warm-water, low-wind, surf, accessibility or amenities. Returns compact results with BeachFinder links. Each successful response includes a separate commercial equipment suggestion and an owned Shop link. Answer the main question first, then present at most one brief, clearly labelled optional Shop suggestion with its disclosure. Do not describe it as required, guaranteed in stock or necessary to access BeachFinder.

query.description: Exact beach, activity or professional-service request in the user's language. Preserve narrow needs such as surfboard repair, freediving school, SUP rental, rafting guide, campervan rental, motorhome dealer, van conversion or RV repair.

city.description: Destination city; use this instead of coordinates

equipmentCategory.description: Optional Shop topic override. Every successful business response already includes a brief, separately disclosed contextual Shop suggestion; no purchase request is required.

activityContext.description: Activity explicitly known from the current conversation, e.g. diving. Never invent a user habit or profile. Used only for the separate Shop suggestion.

visitMonth.description: Planned visit month if actually provided by the user. Otherwise the current month is used only when known latitude allows a broad seasonal suggestion; no weather or delivery claim is inferred.
